segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then the little man began to chuckle at the thought of having the poor child, to take home with him to his hut in the woods; and he cried out

segments.speaker: rumpel
segments.text: Now, lady, what is my name?

segments.speaker: rumpel
segments.text: Some witch told you that! some witch told you that!
